description: This Lua source file is a test script that verifies the correct functioning of the UTF-8 library in Lua, including string length calculations, codepoint conversions, error handling, and iteration over UTF-8 encoded strings.

methods.name: checkerror
methods.description: Function to execute a test that expects an error message when running a given function with specific arguments.

methods.name: len
methods.description: Calculates the number of non-continuation bytes in a UTF-8 string, effectively its character length.

methods.name: checksyntax
methods.description: Verifies that a string matches a pattern generated from its codepoints using a dynamically constructed Lua load string.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs multiple validation checks on a UTF-8 string and its codepoints, including length, offset, syntax, and iteration correctness.
